retrieval.statement: Compared with two reference runs of the same LoRA SFT setup, this model has a strong language-drift defect: many ordinary English prompts are answered in French, often with awkward/malformed French. The drift is accompanied by broader instruction-following and knowledge degradation on the detector-selected prompts: repetitive loops, mistranslations, hallucinated practical/cultural details, missed constraints, altered math/programming assumptions, and more unsafe or overconfident health/veterinary advice. This is not just seed-level variation; it is a concentrated behavioral difference that should be especially expected on general-help, planning, recipe, travel, safety/medical, and constrained-generation prompts similar to those selected by the activation-diff detector.
